title: Admin · {{name}}
noPermission: You don't have admin access to this workspace. Members, devices and invites are managed by the workspace admins.
needPasswordLogin: Admin actions need a password sign-in on the web. You opened the web app from a paired computer without a password (cohive web), so for safety you can't do admin actions here.

joinSelf.notice: You aren't a member of this workspace. You're managing it as a server admin. To see its board and issues, add yourself as a member first.
joinSelf.title: Add yourself to this workspace?
joinSelf.message: You'll join the workspace “{{ws}}” as an admin. You'll appear in its member list, and the chat group will get a join notification.

decide.rejectMessage: Reject the request from “{{name}}”. They'll need to ask again.

signups.title: Sign-up and join requests
signups.description: Requests submitted through a team invite. A new person's sign-up creates an account; someone with an account just joins this workspace.
signups.empty: No sign-up or join requests are waiting.

devices.title: Device requests
devices.description: A member authorized a computer in the browser, but it isn't their first device, so an admin has to approve it before it can be used. Devices belong to the account; once approved, a device works for all the workspaces the member is in.
devices.usedFor: Once approved, it can be used for: {{workspaces}}

members.empty: No members yet. Add an existing account, or create an invite link under Invites.
members.reassigned: Reassigned the issues and services of {{name}}.
members.disabledTitle: This account was deactivated by a server admin
members.disabledWarning: This account is deactivated but still has issues or is registered as a service owner, so new issues are still routed to them. Click Reassign to hand them over.
members.rejoinTitle: Add them back to this workspace?
members.rejoinMessage: “{{name}}” will be a member of this workspace again (role: member), with their previous membership restored.
members.makeAdminMessage: “{{name}}” will be able to approve sign-ups and devices and manage members and invites.
members.demoteSelfMessage: You'll lose admin access to this workspace (server admins excepted) and won't be able to open its admin page again. Remove your own admin rights?
members.demoteMessage: “{{name}}” will no longer be able to manage this workspace.

addMember.title: Add existing account
addMember.usernameHint: Ask them for their username. It has to match exactly.
addMember.badUsername: A username can only contain lowercase letters, digits, underscores and hyphens, 1 to 32 characters.
addMember.notFound: There's no account with the username {{name}}. The username has to match exactly. For someone without an account, use an invite link from Invites.
addMember.disabled: This account is deactivated and can't be added.
addMember.alreadyMember: They're already a member of this workspace.
addMember.wasRemoved: They were removed from this workspace before. Adding them restores their previous membership.

handover.removeDescription: After removal, their coding tool tokens for this workspace stop working immediately and they can no longer see this workspace's board or issues. Their account, devices and other workspaces aren't affected. Their open issues and registered services must be transferred to someone else first.
handover.reassignDescription: Reassign without removing: hand their open issues and registered services to someone else. They stay a member of this workspace.
handover.nothingToRemove: They have no issues or services to transfer.
handover.nothingToReassign: They have no issues or services to reassign.
handover.noCandidatesRemove: No other member can take over (current and not deactivated). Add a member before removing them.
handover.noCandidatesReassign: No other member can take over (current and not deactivated). Add a member before reassigning.
handover.reporterOf: They are the reporter (someone has to take over verifying and closing)
handover.serviceOwnerNote: They are the registered owner. New issues will be routed to the new owner.
handover.missing_one: {{count}} item still has no new owner.
handover.missing_other: {{count}} items still have no new owner.
handover.refreshed: {{message}}. The list was refreshed with the latest changes. Review it and submit again.

devices.description: Computers of the current members of this workspace. Devices belong to the account; revoking one cuts that computer off from every workspace the member is in.
devices.empty: No member has paired a computer yet.
devices.revokeMessage: After you revoke it, {{account}}'s “{{name}}” immediately loses access (including to their other workspaces). To use it again, they need to run cohive login and get approval.

invites.title: Invites created
invites.revokeMessage: The link stops working immediately. Members who already joined with it aren't affected.
invites.linkWarning: The link is shown only once and can't be viewed again after you close this. Copy it now and send it to them. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.

newInvite.title: Create an invite
newInvite.description: Send the link to the person you want to add. A new person opens it and sets their own username and password; someone with an account can sign in and join with it. You can also add someone who already has an account directly under Members.
newInvite.personalDesc: Single use. They can use Cohive right after joining, with no approval.
newInvite.teamDesc: Can be used by several people. An admin has to approve every sign-up or join.
newInvite.asAdmin: Make them an admin when they join
newInvite.maxUsesError: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
newInvite.ttlError: Enter a whole number from 1 to 720 (30 days at most).

workspace.title: Workspace: {{name}}
workspace.nextStepDingtalk: Next: bind the project chat group below (for a DingTalk group use Generate group code; for a Telegram group enter the chat ID). Then add existing accounts under Members, or create an invite link under Invites.
workspace.nextStepSlack: Next: bind the project channel below (for a Slack channel use Generate channel code). Then add existing accounts under Members, or create an invite link under Invites.
workspace.nextStepTelegram: Next: add the Telegram bot to the project group, send /chatid in the group, enter the chat ID below and save. Then add existing accounts under Members, or create an invite link under Invites.
workspace.displayNameHint: The name people see. You can change it any time. Leave it empty to show the path <path>{{path}}</path>. The path appears in links and project config and can't be changed.
workspace.displayNameError: The display name can be at most 40 characters.

language.label: Group message language
language.hint: Group notifications, reminders and bot replies in the group use this language.

workspace.noExternalUrlAdmin: The server has no external URL yet, so group messages go out without links for now. <l>Set it in Server admin → Settings</l>
workspace.noExternalUrlOther: The server has no external URL yet, so group messages go out without links for now. Ask a server admin to set it in Server admin → Settings.
workspace.externalUrlNote: The external URL is shared by the whole server and is set by a server admin.
workspace.botDisabled: The Cohive server has no Telegram bot enabled, so the group settings below have no effect for now. Configure the bot on the server and restart the Cohive server.
workspace.telegramChatBoundDingtalk: This workspace is bound to a DingTalk group. To use a Telegram group instead, unbind the DingTalk group first.
workspace.telegramChatBoundSlack: This workspace is bound to a Slack channel. To use a Telegram group instead, unbind the Slack channel first.
workspace.telegramChatHint: After adding the bot to the group, send /chatid in the group to get it. It looks like -1001234567890. Leave it empty to send no group messages.
workspace.showHint: Turn these off when outsiders are in the group, so only the number and link are sent.

remind.title: Overdue reminders
remind.verify: Waiting for verification for more than <input/> hours
remind.verifyLabel: Reminder after waiting for verification for (hours)
remind.error: Enter a whole number of hours from 0 to 720.
remind.hint: When the time is up, the person involved is @-mentioned in the group again. If nothing happens within the same time again, the workspace admins are @-mentioned too, and then no more reminders. Time is counted on the clock; “Fixing” isn't counted, and any status change restarts the timer. Enter 0 to turn reminders off.

workspace.readOnly: This workspace is archived and its settings are read-only. Unarchive it to make changes.

archive.title: Archive
archive.description: An archived workspace is read-only, hidden from the switcher and gets no reminders. Data is kept and you can unarchive any time.
archive.openIssuesCheck: I know {{count}} issues are still unfinished. Archive anyway
archive.plain: After archiving, members can only view; no new issues or actions.
archive.unarchiveMessage: The workspace becomes writable again and reappears in the switcher.
archive.recount: The number of unfinished issues is now {{count}}. Please confirm again.
